limitations: 72hours are accelerated logical time. This is not72hours of continuous real-time execution or a hardware capacity benchmark.
SIGKILL covers process death and actual SQLite WAL/transaction recovery, not host power loss, disk corruption, disk-full or network filesystem behavior.
Tests call RestaurantService directly, not through Uvicorn/HTTP. HTTP authentication/transport and full Engine startup are covered elsewhere or remain outside this specialist evidence.
Telegram request transport is httpx.MockTransport; real Telegram delivery and exactly-once provider delivery are not established.
No physical cameras, detector accuracy or production database were used.

methodological_notes.initial_assertion: All visits ended before retention cutoff must be deleted.
methodological_notes.correction: A newer cleanup notification legitimately keeps its older ended visit. Test now checks only unreferenced ended visits whose notifications are also eligible for deletion.
